ensuring compatibility among them. All transportation, transit insurance required for supply and commissioning of t he Network system are to be arranged by the bidder and no extra cost shall be paid. Any damage to the material and system supplied through this contract un til the handover of the system shall be the responsibility of the bidder and insur ance (if any) required to mitigate the risk shall be borne by the bidder. The bidder shall furnish and install structured cable using casing capping, duct, conduit, straps, casing capping T joints and L joints where necessary to perform the scope of work described herein. No network cable/wiring shall be left e xposed. 2. The connectivity from LAN switch and UTP patch panel shall be extended throu gh UTP patch chords. All network cabling/wiring shall be properly protect ed and routed through conduit, flexible piping, protective jacket, casin g/capping or equivalent suitable cable protection. 3. Laying and Termination of CAT6 Cable with casing and capping/spiral pipe or o ther suitable cable protection wherever required. All cabling must be “structure d” with proper fitting. 4. The quantity of 75 I/O Boxes specified in the Tech Specs shall represent the p resent requirement only and shall not limit the extent of CAT6 cable wiring. The bidder shall carry out CAT6 cable wiring to additional/future locations as directe d by FRI, even after installation of the specified 75 I/O Boxes, provided suffici ent CAT6 cable is available within the sanctioned/procured cable quant ity. All splicing access ories and consumables required for the above work shall be provided by the bid der. 6. Any defect, failure, loose connection, im

proper termination or other fault attributable to the supplied material or workm anship during the warranty period shall be rectified by the bidder at their own c ost, without any additional financial liability to FRI. 7. Suitable lockable network rack / wall-mount cabinet is to be provided & installed by the vendor with proper Rack leveling, anchoring and earthing & oth er required steps for the supplied switch. 2.
